title: Assertion: Acknowledge Within 5 Cycles
constraints: Rule: every cycle with `req = 1` must be followed by `ack = 1` within 1 to 5 cycles (`req` is a single-cycle pulse).
The testbench always runs long enough for pending obligations to be decided.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: An ack in the same cycle as req does not count (the window starts at 1).

examples.title: fast ack
examples.input: req, then ack two cycles later
